meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Runs maximum-saturation research with a cooperating team, claim-graph gating, and a cited, QA'd deliverable. Use when the user explicitly asks for research or a deep investigation, including any 'ulw' research wording.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一个模糊的问题,查成一份带出处、经复核的研究报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有个问题需要翻遍资料、还得清楚标明出处。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a vague question into a cited, fact-checked research report
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must answer a question from many sources, with citations.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会就你指定的主题拉起一支研究团队:分头查遍相关来源、顺着线索一路追下去、互相辩论争议点,并用运行代码来证实或推翻有争议的说法,最后交出一份每条结论都带引用或证明的成果。
howto.when: 当你明确要求做研究或深度调查,或说出 “ulw-research”、“ultradebate” 等关键词时触发。普通的提问、调试、或别的模式收集上下文不会触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 研究一下这个主题
say.note: 它会先问你要什么格式的成果,再组建团队

say.text: 对这个仓库做一次深度调查,我要 PDF 报告
say.note: 会按你选的格式和模板产出带引用的文档

say.text: 查一下这个问题,并辩论其中有争议的结论
say.note: 争议结论会经辩论或被运行代码验证

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude spins up a research team for your topic: fanning out over sources, chasing leads, debating contested points, and proving or refuting them by running code, then delivering a synthesis where every claim carries a citation or proof.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask for research or a deep investigation, or use wording like "ulw-research" or "ultradebate". Ordinary questions, debugging, or another mode's context-gathering do not trigger it.

say_en.note: It first asks which output format you want, then builds the team

say_en.text: Do a deep investigation of this repo, give me a PDF report
say_en.note: Produces a cited document in your chosen format and template

say_en.text: Research this question and debate the contested claims
say_en.note: Contested claims get debated or verified by running code
